'''Savess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Warrior]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], she resided in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
